title: Chevening Scholarships Kenya 2027/28
description: UK Government scholarship for future leaders from Kenya to pursue a one-year taught master's degree in the UK.
eligibility: Kenyan citizen; undergraduate degree; at least two years of qualifying work experience; meet Chevening eligibility rules.
benefits: Full financial support for a one-year master's, subject to Chevening terms.
requirements: Eligible citizenship, undergraduate qualification, required work experience, three eligible UK course choices, references and education documents.

title: Reach Oxford Scholarship 2027
description: Oxford undergraduate scholarship for students from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their home country.
eligibility: Nationals of eligible low-income countries who receive an Oxford undergraduate offer and meet scholarship criteria.
benefits: Course fees, annual living-cost grant and one return airfare per year.
requirements: Apply for and receive an Oxford undergraduate offer and meet the scholarship's nationality and academic criteria.

title: Oxford Mastercard Foundation AfOx Graduate Scholarships 2027/28
organization: University of Oxford / Mastercard Foundation / AfOx
description: Scholarships for African candidates applying to eligible full-time taught postgraduate courses at Oxford.
eligibility: African citizen ordinarily resident in Africa with an eligible Oxford course offer and demonstrated leadership and service.
benefits: Course fees and a grant for living costs, plus scholar support and development opportunities.
requirements: Submit an eligible Oxford graduate application by the relevant course funding deadline and satisfy scholarship criteria.

title: Oxford Optiver Foundation Scholarships 2027
field: Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering, Mathematics
description: Scholarships supporting women from eligible low- and middle-income countries studying selected postgraduate science courses at Oxford.
eligibility: Female applicants ordinarily resident in an eligible country applying for an eligible master's course beginning October 2027.
benefits: Full course fees and a grant for living costs, plus mentoring and on-course support.
requirements: Apply for an eligible Oxford master's course and meet course and scholarship criteria.

title: HELB Postgraduate Partial Scholarship 2026/27
description: Kenyan postgraduate scholarship for students enrolled in recognized local public or private universities. The 2026/27 cycle has closed; monitor HELB for the next call.
eligibility: Kenyan student admitted to a master's or PhD programme at a CUE-recognized local university; minimum Second-Class Upper Division.
benefits: Up to KSh 200,000 for Master's and KSh 450,000 for PhD under the 2026/27 call.
requirements: Admission letter, academic qualification, programme eligibility and HELB/HEF application documents.

title: Kenya Government Undergraduate Scholarship — HEF 2026/27
description: Government scholarship support for eligible Kenyan students placed in public universities under the Student-Centred Funding Model.
eligibility: Kenyan citizen placed in a public university by KUCCPS and meeting current HEF/Universities Fund eligibility rules.
benefits: Government scholarship contribution assessed according to financial need.
requirements: Admission letter, KCPE/KCSE details, identity and family information, passport photo and HEF application.

title: Elimu Scholarship Programme — Kenya Secondary School
description: Kenya Ministry of Education programme supporting eligible learners from vulnerable and disadvantaged backgrounds. Intake and dates are announced by the Ministry.
eligibility: Eligible Kenyan learners meeting the current Ministry Elimu Scholarship criteria for the relevant intake.
benefits: Education support package defined in the current Elimu Scholarship call.
requirements: Current Ministry application form, learner and guardian identification, school/admission information and documents in the active call.
